data.body: RP-05 overview decision approved (2026-08-18): `rebar --help`/`rebar help` will become a comprehensive, grouped overview of every canonical public top-level command. Canonical names appear exactly once. Compatibility aliases are not duplicated in the overview; an explicitly requested accepted alias may resolve canonical help subject to the separate alias-policy decision. Hidden aliases remain absent from discovery, and retired spellings remain unknown. This intentionally replaces the current two-tier overview, which lists 54 package-help-backed commands but omits 21 public advanced verbs. Maintained-project basis: pip and Django enumerate registered commands; kubectl groups non-hidden commands; Git demonstrates that a curated overview requires a separate all-commands path, which Rebar will not need after this decision.
